slides.title:
The [[ADHD]]
morning,
in five [[scenes]].
slides.sub: Swipe if any of these are you.

slides.title:
Awake, but
not [[up]]
slides.body: You've been awake for forty minutes. You've planned the whole day in your head. You have not moved.

slides.title:
Coffee first.
Then [[coffee]].
slides.body: You make it, put it down, and find it cold at eleven. Making it was the task. Drinking it was a different task.

slides.title:
Twelve tabs,
zero [[starts]]
slides.body: Everything feels urgent, so nothing gets picked. You open all of it and do none of it.

slides.title:
Getting dressed
is a [[project]]
slides.body: Find the shirt. Get distracted by the drawer. Remember the shirt. Discover the shirt is in the wash.

slides.title:
It's 10:40 and
you're [[tired]]
slides.body: Not from doing things. From deciding things. Every choice cost something, and none of them were the day.

slides.title:
Which one
is [[you]]?
slides.body: Tell us in the comments. Then dump the rest into my.adhd and get back one thing to start with.
